editorial:
Imagine walking into a wedding where half the guests are alive and the other half are literally rotting away. That is the wild setup here, as you follow a brave human bride and her zombie groom trying to tie the knot. The vibe is a total blast, mixing goofy laughs with some creepy moments. You get to see the awkwardness of the human guests trying to follow a handbook on zombie etiquette while the WWN news crew tries to sneak around to get the big scoop. It feels like a party that could go wrong at any second, and the chemistry between the couple is surprisingly sweet despite the makeup and fake blood.

What really works is the fast pacing and the funny dialogue that keeps you grinning. The acting is spot on, especially the news reporters who are terrified but still trying to get a good shot. While some of the special effects look a bit cheap, it actually adds to the campy charm of the film. If you love weird rom-coms, you should definitely check this out. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or if you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your shelf is a great move.
endingExplained: In the final act, the zombie groom loses control and starts chasing the guests, but the bride uses a special calming perfume to stop him. The big twist is that the WWN reporters were actually trying to steal a cure for zombification hidden in the cake. They fail miserably and end up getting bitten. The movie ends with the happy couple dancing while the reporters become the newest members of the zombie wedding party.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves quirky horror comedies and weird romance.
